title: Työsopimuslaki 1:4 § and 2:4 §: selvitys työnteon keskeisistä ehdoista
source: Työsopimuslaki (55/2001), 1 luku 4 § and 2 luku 4 §, Finlex consolidated text through 412/2026 (in force 1 June 2026). Read 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: Items 1 to 8 are given within seven days of the start and 9 to 15 within a month; work abroad before departure.
The parties with their homes or places of business, the start, the place of work and the main duties.
A fixed term gives its end or estimated end and its ground, or that it was made without a justified reason (1 luku 3 § as amended by 412/2026).
A probation of at most six months, and in a fixed term at most half of it.
The basis of the pay and the pay period.
The working time; for a variable working time when and how much work is needed and the days and hours work may be ordered without consent.
Agency work, training, annual leave, the notice period, the collective agreement, and the insurers of the pension and of accidents at work.
Only items 4, 7, 8 and 11 to 15 may point to the law or the collective agreement.
Work abroad for a month or more: the countries, length, currency, benefits and terms of return.
The statement is written in Finnish throughout, headings included.
rules.source: house rule for a Finnish document
